purpose: Illustrative artwork for the homepage About section ("Architecture, precision and people. Together, under one roof."). It is a generated image and does not show a real QS Realty building, office or people.

assets.tool: ElevenLabs image generation (model gpt-image-2.5-sunburst), made in two steps: a dusk version first, then an edit of that picture into the white daytime version
assets.prompt_step_1: Use case: cinematic architectural illustration for a luxury property developer's website, wide landscape 16:9. A photorealistic cross-section cutaway of an elegant contemporary three-storey building at dusk, like a refined architectural dollhouse seen straight on, placed on the right two-thirds of the frame. Ground floor: an architects' studio with drawing tables, rolled plans and a small ivory building model. Middle floor: engineers reviewing structural drawings beside brass surveying instruments and material samples. Top floor: a family relaxing in a warm, beautifully finished living room. One single clean roof line with a thin brass edge covers all three floors. Warm golden interior light glowing against a deep olive-charcoal evening sky, subtle garden planting at the base. The left third of the frame is calm, dark, empty olive-charcoal space. Palette: deep olive charcoal, warm gold light, ivory, travertine. Luxurious, quiet, highly detailed. No text, no letters, no signage, no logo, no watermark.
assets.prompt_step_2: Keep exactly the same composition, camera angle and position in the frame as the reference image: the same three-storey building cross-section cutaway seen straight on, the same three floors and people (a family relaxing in the living room on the top floor, two engineers at the drawing table with the surveying instrument on the middle floor, the architects' studio with drawing tables and a building model on the ground floor), the same single roof and the same garden planting at the base. Change the dark dusk scene into a clean, bright, premium white daytime look that matches a light website page: replace the dark sky and dark trees with a seamless soft warm-white background in the exact paper tone #f3f0e9; soft, diffused natural daylight; the building structure, floor slabs and columns in matte white and pale ivory stone, with one thin brushed-brass line along the roof edge; interiors bright, airy and softly sunlit with pale oak and ivory furniture, a few brass details and gentle warm lamps; garden trees and shrubs in light, muted sage green; very soft pale shadows, no black areas anywhere. The left third of the frame becomes completely clean, flat warm-white empty space. Elegant, calm, high-end architectural visualisation. No text, no letters, no signage, no logo, no watermark.
assets.notes: The picture's background is the page's paper tone, so the site fades its edges instead of framing it. The three floor labels (Architecture, Precision, People) are HTML placed over the image by percentage, so a replacement image must keep the same composition or the label positions in index.html need updating. This file is preview resolution; a sharper remake would replace it at the same path.
